desc:
Bedside Manner: Co-op Hospital Horror Escape

You wake up alone in an abandoned hospital. The phone rings. A nurse's voice warns of a lockdown... but it isn't a nurse. Something is imitating her...

Explore dark rooms, solve puzzles, crack the color code keypad, kick down doors and escape before the creature finds you. Play solo or with friends, power the generators and sprint to freedom.

CONTROLS
PC: WASD Move | Shift Sprint | F Kick | Q Flashlight | E Interact | Tab Inventory | Click Throw decoy | Space Generator (Q leave) | Y/N Revive | Q/E Spectate
Controller: B/L3 Sprint | RT Kick/Throw | LT Flashlight | X Interact | Select Inventory | A Generator (B leave) | D-Pad Up/Down Revive | LB/RB Spectate
Mobile: RUN, KICK, LIGHT buttons, tap to interact

[CHAPTER 2 IN DEV]

roblox horror, horror game, scary game
